record: audio record — phase 14 (causal redo). Every line of the settled text was synthesized fresh for this branch.
reuse_rule_outcome: ZERO lines reused. The reuse provision (verified takes may serve lines whose text survived re-derivation identically) found no eligible line: the per-line account in phase 11 records zero verbatim survivals, so all ten lines were synthesized new — the provision was applied, not skipped.

jobs.result: 9 lines verified (alignment 1.0; L3 at 0.9 — single-token ASR variant "their" for the spoken "there", enumerated per the standard, not waved); L2 FAILED verification (0.8; ASR heard "re" for "are"); diagnostic audio for the failed take is operator-side only, which restricted the residual choice to re-synthesis.

jobs.mode: icl (the ONE residual regeneration the standard allows for a failed line)
jobs.reference: this job's own verified L10 take (same session, same voice) with L10's verbatim text as ref_text — the strongest same-narration reference the Qwen playbook ranks first
jobs.result: take 1 failed verification identically (0.8); take 2 PASSED at alignment 1.0 — chosen per the ICL rule (the verifier-passed take; its fit requirement is atempo 1.000).

voice_character_note: Nine lines are one registered voice; L2 is the single ICL line — the exact configuration the owner's ear flagged on wd-02 (an ICL line can differ in character from registered takes). It is named here, not hidden; the owner's ear verdict on this piece's assembled take is the check that can retire the concern.
trim_rule: silence-cluster-merge, the lane standard: ffmpeg silencedetect at -45 dB, min silence 0.25 s; clusters merged across gaps < 0.35 s; 50 ms pads kept at speech edges

fit.rule: window = trimmed duration + planned gap; fit requires window - 0.15 s guard - duration >= 0.02 s at atempo 1.0
fit.outcome: all 10 lines fit at atempo 1.000 (no time-stretch anywhere); every planned gap >= 0.35 s survives intact; zero overlap by construction (phase 11 §5 arithmetic)

bed.source: files/short-soa01-renters-musiconly.mp4 (the first draft's music-only twin, sha256 30479aca4d1ecbcb...) — MUSIC-ASSET extraction, recorded as such: the bed is a produced music asset, not a design decision of the old build; reusing it does not import the old video's structure
bed.handling: extracted to WAV (34.30 s), loop-extended to the 35.54 s programme with a 3 s crossfade; single measured scalar gain of -11.13 dB in the final assembly, placing it 13 dB under the voice programme; continuous throughout — pauses are narration events, the bed never gates (the owner's standing rule)

assembly_chain: Per-stem chain (durations and timings untouched): acompressor(threshold -16 dB, ratio 3, attack 2 ms, release 120 ms) -> single measured scalar gain per stem toward a uniform -13.8 LUFS stem target (stems landed -12.1..-13.5 LUFS, a 1.4 dB spread) -> an alimiter stage (limit=0.80) that measurement shows did NOT cap peaks as intended (post-stage stem true peaks read ~0 dBTP; the stage is recorded as applied-but-ineffective, not as a control). Stems placed at the locked starts; bed (the first draft music-only twin, loop-extended with a 3 s crossfade) at a single measured scalar 13 dB under the voice programme; the master two-pass loudnorm delivered the verified result on the delivered file: -14.56 LUFS integrated, TP -1.49 dBTP. Two earlier assemblies were measured and NOT shipped (uncompressed stems: -16.84 LUFS; scalar-capped stems: -15.50 LUFS). The raw takes peak near 0 dBFS over a -18..-22 LUFS body - the measured reason any chain was needed.
